AbstractText.Label: PURPOSE
AbstractText.content: To define the term complexity of care.

AbstractText.Label: BACKGROUND
AbstractText.content: The aging population and lack of gerontological preparation in pre-licensure nursing programs are pressing issues. The NLN Advancing Care Excellence for Seniors (ACE.S) project developed a framework to facilitate faculty and student understanding of older adults' care needs. Integral to the framework is the concept of complexity of care.

AbstractText.Label: METHOD
AbstractText.content: Rogers and Knafl's evolutionary method of concept analysis was used.

AbstractText.Label: RESULTS
AbstractText.content: The analysis identified three antecedents (focus on treatment and cure of disease, multiple comorbidities, and life experiences and culture), five attributes (polypharmacy, use of advanced technologies, novel care models, a fragmented health care system, and the relational nature of caregiving), and two consequences (impact on quality of life and impact on quality of care).

AbstractText.Label: CONCLUSION
AbstractText.content: Defining the concept of complexity of care will facilitate student understanding of the unique health care needs of older adults.

Article.ArticleTitle: Complexity of Care: A Concept Analysis of Older Adult Health Care Experiences.
